purpose: Verify successful new scholarship application flow from Draft to Verified/Routed.
preconditions: Student is authenticated; scholarship is published and open; student meets eligibility pre-checks.
action_or_input: Student submits application with required data and documents. SPACS Assistant opens the assigned task and verifies the application.
expected_result: Application state transitions: Draft -> Submitted -> Under Verification -> Verified/Routed for Decision.

purpose: Verify correction request and successful resubmission flow.
preconditions: Application is in 'Under Verification' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Assistant requests correction/additional information. Student modifies and resubmits. Assistant reverifies.
expected_result: State transitions: Under Verification -> Correction Required -> Resubmitted -> Verified/Routed for Decision.

purpose: Verify scholarship approval path.
preconditions: Application is in 'Verified/Routed for Decision' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener opens the decision task and approves the application.
expected_result: State transitions: Verified/Routed for Decision -> Under Convener Review -> Approved.

purpose: Verify scholarship rejection path from Verification Concern.
preconditions: Application is in 'Verification Concern' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener opens the decision task and rejects the application.
expected_result: State transitions: Verification Concern -> Under Convener Review -> Rejected.

purpose: Verify student can withdraw application from Submitted state.
preconditions: Application is in 'Submitted' state; no final decision has been made.
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of the application.
expected_result: Application state changes to 'Withdrawn'; pending tasks are closed; action is logged.

purpose: Verify student can withdraw application from Under Verification state.
preconditions: Application is in 'Under Verification' state and not locked by policy.
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of the application.
expected_result: Application state changes to 'Withdrawn'.

purpose: Verify student can withdraw application from Correction Required state.
preconditions: Application is in 'Correction Required' state.
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of the application.
expected_result: Application state changes to 'Withdrawn'.

purpose: Verify withdrawal from Verified/Routed is allowed only if Convener review hasn't begun and scheme permits.
preconditions: Application is in 'Verified/Routed for Decision'; Convener has not opened the task; scheme marks state as withdrawable.
action_or_input: Student requests withdrawal of the application.
expected_result: Application state changes to 'Withdrawn'.

purpose: Verify renewal submission and successful verification.
preconditions: Scholarship is renewable; renewal window is open; student is eligible.
action_or_input: Student submits renewal application. SPACS Assistant opens and verifies the renewal.
expected_result: State transitions: Awarded/Renewal Eligible -> Renewal Submitted -> Renewal Under Verification -> Renewal Verified/Routed.

purpose: Verify renewal approval path.
preconditions: Renewal application is in 'Renewal Verified/Routed' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener opens the renewal decision and approves.
expected_result: State transitions: Renewal Verified/Routed -> Renewal Under Decision -> Renewed/Approved.

purpose: Verify renewal rejection path.
preconditions: Renewal application is in 'Renewal Verified/Routed' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener opens the renewal decision and rejects.
expected_result: State transitions: Renewal Verified/Routed -> Renewal Under Decision -> Renewal Rejected.

purpose: Verify award cycle candidate pool preparation and committee evaluation.
preconditions: Award cycle is open.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener prepares the candidate pool. Award Evaluation Committee begins evaluation and records the result.
expected_result: State transitions: Award Cycle Open -> Candidate Pool Prepared -> Under Committee Evaluation -> Committee Result Recorded.

purpose: Verify award finalization and publication when approval is already available.
preconditions: Committee result is recorded; required institutional approval evidence is already available.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener records the final outcome and publishes the results.
expected_result: State transitions: Committee Result Recorded -> Ready for Publication -> Published.

purpose: Verify award finalization when institutional approval is pending.
preconditions: Committee result is recorded; required institutional approval evidence is not yet available.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener attempts to record outcome (transitions to Awaiting). Later, Convener records the approval evidence and publishes.
expected_result: State transitions: Committee Result Recorded -> Awaiting Institutional Approval -> Ready for Publication -> Published.

purpose: Verify Convener can return a verified application for correction.
preconditions: Application is in 'Under Convener Review' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener returns the application for correction.
expected_result: State transitions to 'Correction Required'.

purpose: Verify Assistant can route an unresolved verification concern to Convener.
preconditions: Application is in 'Under Verification' state; Assistant finds an unresolved concern (e.g., suspected ineligibility).
action_or_input: SPACS Assistant records the verification concern.
expected_result: State transitions to 'Verification Concern/Routed'.

purpose: Verify renewal correction request and resubmission flow.
preconditions: Renewal application is in 'Renewal Under Verification' state.
action_or_input: SPACS Assistant requests correction. Student resubmits the renewal. Assistant reverifies.
expected_result: State transitions: Renewal Under Verification -> Correction Required -> Renewal Resubmitted -> Renewal Verified/Routed.

purpose: Verify system prevents duplicate active/submitted applications for the same student, scholarship, and cycle.
preconditions: Student has an active or submitted application for a specific scholarship in the current academic cycle.
action_or_input: Student attempts to start another application for the same scholarship and cycle.
expected_result: System prevents the action and displays a validation error.

purpose: Verify previously uploaded documents can only be reused if still valid and acceptable for the selected scheme.
preconditions: Student has a previously uploaded document that is expired or not acceptable for the selected scheme.
action_or_input: Student attempts to reuse the invalid/expired document for a new application.
expected_result: System rejects the document reuse and requires a new upload.

purpose: Verify draft applications are preserved on recoverable timeout or system error.
preconditions: Student is actively filling out an application draft.
action_or_input: A recoverable timeout or system error occurs during the session.
expected_result: System preserves the draft data so it can be recovered upon the student's next login.

purpose: Verify significant actions are time-stamped and audit logged.
preconditions: User is authenticated and performs a significant action (e.g., submission, decision, catalogue publication).
action_or_input: The significant action is executed in the system.
expected_result: System creates an audit log entry with timestamp, actor, and action details. The log is protected from ordinary modification.

purpose: Verify uncompleted tasks are routed according to currently configured role assignment when a role holder changes.
preconditions: A task is assigned to Role A, currently held by User X. User Y is subsequently assigned to Role A.
action_or_input: Role holder changes from User X to User Y.
expected_result: Uncompleted tasks for Role A are now accessible and routed to User Y without altering previously recorded actor/audit history.
